what: Zero-findings short-circuit vs loop edge case

suggested_fix: Implement the plan-review.md:108 path in plan-review-loop.sh (or explicitly amend plan-review.md + SKILL.md + Gate B expectations together with a regression test)

scenario_or_breakage: plan-review-loop.sh step 4 omits --substantive-validation --validation-mode --structured-reviewer-validation and uses default 1800s not 1860s; breaks substantive-validation contract #661 and scripts/test-design-structure.sh:216-229
suggested_fix: Mirror the single-line collect invocation from plan-review.md (and extend pins to assert those flags survive the refactor)

scenario_or_breakage: plan-review.md requires Mid-Run Dirty-Tree Probe (heavy-worker STAGE=plan-review-collection) immediately after collect returns; the proposed loop steps do not include it
suggested_fix: Either invoke the same probe from plan-review-loop.sh after collect or relocate the contract into SKILL.md with an explicit sequencing guarantee

scenario_or_breakage: The only block_has_severity enforcement today is on merged aggregator output blocks in main() not on raw input; gating only an imaginary input check would still fail validation when merge output lacks Severity
suggested_fix: Extend --input-mode plan to skip merged-output severity validation (same gate as input would be wrong); update aggregate-findings.md accordingly

scenario_or_breakage: lib-voter-parse-rate.sh only holds diag helpers; check_voter_parse_rate and check_and_retry_voter_parse_rate live in dispatch-code-voters.sh and are ballot-shape-specific
suggested_fix: Plan dispatch-plan-voters work to either factor real shared helpers or adapt plan-specific substantive checks (see existing check_plan_voter_substantive) instead of only sourcing lib-voter-parse-rate.sh

what: Naive reuse of code voter parse-rate for plan ballots

suggested_fix: Extend parse-rate logic for FINDING|OOS vote grammar or keep plan-specific check_plan_voter_substantive for Claude plan voter
